Research Question: Can qwen3.8-max produce at least two fully acceptable verified demonstrations on the unchanged training20 for the first LoRA probe?
Hypothesis: The teacher reduces grounding and argument mistakes, but every full trajectory still requires explicit review.
Independent Variable: Teacher policy and API serialization instead of local Qwen3-8B; tokenizer differences are recorded, not treated as a perfectly controlled capability comparison
Controlled Variables: same initial messages and tool schemas
Metrics: provider usage and student tokens separately
Evidence Gate: Real tools/state and online/replay agreement; explicit full-trajectory approval on at least two independent tasks; no truncated targets or dropped turns; student encoding within8192. Acquisition does not automatically launch training.
Cost Bound: At most20 trajectories and120 API requests, sequential; six turns/task; output768/call and2048/task using provider usage, additionally2048 canonical student targets/task; process1800s and request90s; no retries. Planning estimate4-15RMB, not a hard monetary bound. Budget approval threshold was waived by the user; measured known cost and unavailable error-request cost are separate.
Failure Branch: Stop on API/infrastructure failure or contract violation, preserve partial evidence and unknown charges. Policy/tool failures remain recorded; no automatic sample replacement, prompt editing, context expansion or SFT.
seed_reproducibility: Requested API seed; backend determinism and weight revision not guaranteed
